      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "misplaced comma in string literal causes the ipc test directory filter to match nothing",
      "quote": "The comma in `'src/ipc/test/',` ends up inside the element, so it still matches nothing.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author fixed the comma placement",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901520983"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:3901520983",

      "id": "c:5837787085",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "extract the lint commit into a separate PR to merge quickly and combine the scripted diffs into a single commit",
      "quote": "maybe we could extract the lint commit into a separate PR - that one is conflict-free and should pass quickly.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author prefers keeping bundled and noted conflicts are trivial",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5873828770"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5873828770",
      "status_by_quote": "The changes and scripts should be easy enough to keep bundled here."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5837787085",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "could the include insertion skip the first-#include line-number lookup and just insert at the top of the file?",
      "quote": "could the include insertion skip the first-`#include` line-number lookup and just insert at the top of the file?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained clang-format limitation",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5873828770"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5873828770",
      "status_by_quote": "clang-format can't move includes over `//` comment lines. So this won't work."
    }
  ],
